name: join-composite-numeric
description: Measure two and three numeric equality key hash joins

queries.name: two-key-facts
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.amount FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id AND e.user_id = f.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: reverse-two-keys
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.quantity FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.user_id = f.user_id AND f.event_id = e.event_id ORDER BY e.event_id DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: three-key-facts
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, f.category FROM events e JOIN events f ON e.event_id = f.event_id AND e.user_id = f.user_id AND e.quantity = f.quantity ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
